title: Blocking consumer qualification
summary: The built-archive consumer check (core, core+Filament in a clean Laravel 13 application) is a blocking job in the tests workflow and a required step of the release validate job, so neither a merge nor a tag release can pass with a broken archive or an unreachable Packagist.
why: I19 moves from non-blocking to blocking in P1; release-gate condition 9 says a tag release cannot bypass it (owner amendment D14). Packagist unavailability (exit 3) is 'proves nothing' and must never be green.

include: .github/workflows/tests.yml job consumer-fixture: remove `continue-on-error: true` and the stale comment that points to PLAN2.P8.3; keep both steps (core; core+Filament)

.github/workflows/release.yml job validate: add PHP extensions needed by the fixture (zip, pdo_sqlite, sqlite3) and two steps running `bash bin/consumer-fixture.sh --laravel=13 --version="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"` and the same with `--with-filament`, after Tests and before the changelog preflight
bin/consumer-fixture.sh: only if needed so a pre-release tag version (e.g. 1.0.0-rc.1) builds and installs; exit-code contract 0/1/2/3 unchanged
exclude: Core-only inactive-cost consumer variant and module-relocation rehearsal (P3/P4)

reads.why: Condition 9 and the consumer/distribution CI row
Arguments, archive build from copies, exit codes
Job that gains the consumer steps

task_files.note: only if a pre-release version needs it

rules: Exit 3 (Packagist unreachable) fails the job; never add `|| true`, `continue-on-error` or a retry that turns 3 into 0.
Keep the workflow hardening style already used (pinned major actions, minimal permissions, no new secrets); the zizmor workflow must stay clean.
Do not change test selection of other jobs.
guidance: Run the fixture locally once per variant to prove it is green on the 0.7.0 tree before making it blocking; if it is red, stop and report instead of weakening the gate. Validate workflow syntax with actionlint (installed locally).
deliverables: Consumer steps (core, core+Filament) in release.yml validate

result.notes: tests.yml consumer-fixture job is blocking (continue-on-error and stale PLAN2.P8.3 comment removed). release.yml validate: extensions zip, pdo_sqlite, sqlite3; consumer steps core and core+Filament with --version=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v} after Tests, before changelog preflight. bin/consumer-fixture.sh unchanged: local run with --version=1.0.0-rc.1 --with-filament exits 0. Owner-requested grok/grok-4.7/high review GREEN (artifacts/reviews/P1.5-review.json).
deviations: V4 as authored exits 1 on the untouched Codecov upload step (tests.yml coverage job; its continue-on-error predates P1.5 and changing it would alter another job). Scoped equivalent passes: the consumer-fixture job has no continue-on-error; release.yml has exactly 2 consumer-fixture.sh steps.
